activation_rules: A candidate may advance only when the preceding stage is evidenced.
Failure, PIT uncertainty, missing identity, data corruption, or unexplained regression forces HOLD or DEGRADE.
Sparse candidates inherit the validated parent/global method and remain out of scope-specific production.
Competition-specific research never changes the active prediction scope by itself.
LIMITED_PRODUCTION and above require an explicit PROJECT_SCOPE_POLICY change plus all release gates.
Only one new target may enter advanced validation per expansion cycle; other candidates remain queued.

candidate_sources.active_sports: Discover unrecognized explicit competition_id values from current sport databases without silently activating them.
